summary: KITRON ASA (org. no. 976 605 713) is a public limited company (ASA) based in Asker, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-07-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 26.120 (Produksjon av kretskort); it has 11 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 258.8 m and net income was NOK 222.2 m. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 738.0 m. CEO: Lars Peter Nilsson; board chair: Tuomo Juhani Lähdesmäki; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Also: LEI 5967007LIEEXZXIG6009.
